description: Create a mandate account: a smart account that is itself a sponsor, so limits can bind a session key. Existing positions can't be moved into it. The owner can never change: there is no owner recovery. Unaudited. Refused while mandates aren't enabled on this server. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the owner's own wallet; simulated first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

owner.description: The user's wallet address (0x...). Used to read the position and as the simulated sender; nothing is signed.

salt.description: Optional: a whole number or 32 bytes of hex, to create more than one account

name: prepare_mandate_create
title: Prepare mandate account
